coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: MB360 (1200 4th St)
record.summary: MB360 (1200 4th St) is a residential building (177 units per the DataSF Assessor roll), part of a two-block Mission Bay apartment development (the other block is 701 China Basin St, tracked as its own record) originally built by BRE Properties (now Essex Property Trust), with MVE + Partners as prime architect. The architect's project page gives different unit counts (Block 5 = 170, Block 11 = 190) and does not say which block is 1200 4th St. DataSF Assessor records give 2016 as this parcel's year built, and the architect's project page gives 'Completion 2016' for the development.

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL lot geometry -- the outline is Assessor lot 8711017 (7,383 m2, active), so its edges are recorded lot lines, not a surveyed building footprint: it includes any yard, setback or plaza inside the lot and can sit a little off the walls. Until 2026-10-12 this record showed the surveyed building footprint (DataSF Building Footprints (mblr SF8711017)); 96% of that outline lies inside the lot and it covered 91% of the lot.
notes.digitized_from: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lot 8711017 (mapped 2006-05-22; active); the earlier outline came from: DataSF Building Footprints (mblr SF8711017); address confirmed via DataSF Assessor parcel data (blklot 8711017) and apartment-listing sources that name this address as part of the MB360 complex

milestones.text: BRE Properties' ~360-unit MB360 development (Blocks 5 and 11 of Mission Bay, per the architect's project page) is reported to have begun vertical construction. The Registry, published May 1, 2013, says BRE "has begun vertical construction on its 360-unit MB360 apartment development"; that is an announcement, so the start date itself is not known and only the year is shown. No source read ties the start to this address in particular

changes.text: The 2013 start is shown as a year, from a May 1, 2013 announcement. The 177-unit figure comes from the Assessor roll; the architect's page gives different per-block counts. CBS News reported that the March 11, 2014 fire destroyed a 172-unit MB360 building under construction; no source gives that building's address.
MB360 (1200 4th St) now uses its Assessor lot lines.

The map notes attributed the two-address premise to apartments.com and Zillow listings that are not cited; the two-block development is now cited to Ignition Architecture's project page (Blocks 5/11), and the 701 China Basin St address to the Assessor roll. The summary no longer gives a 2014 Essex acquisition year, the CBS News source title matches its displayed headline, the NAIP photo credit names the Farm Production and Conservation Business Center, and the Commons photo no longer says it was taken from a departing flight.

open_questions: The 2016 year rests on the Assessor's year-built field and the architect's undated project page ("Completion 2016"); no report written after the completion was found, and no source read gives a different year for this block.

CBS News San Francisco (May 7, 2014) reported that the March 11, 2014 five-alarm fire was at a construction site "at Fourth and China Basins streets, where a 172-unit building was being built as part of the MB360 development project" and that "the unfinished building was destroyed and demolished"; SFGate (March 2014) reported the five-alarm fire at a building on Fourth Street near China Basin Street, part of a 360-unit complex (it gives no unit count for the building itself). The 172 count is close to this block's 177-unit Assessor count, but no source found gives the destroyed building's street address explicitly, so the fire is not asserted here as having happened to this specific block.
Precise month of this block's actual completion/first occupancy is not sourced beyond the bare Assessor year.
Not yet researched: developer of record beyond BRE Properties/Essex Property Trust, and any subsequent sale history.
